summary: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench for a needed cog #5. Bring it back to Lotwil.

sections.title: Cog Number Five
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus turns his attention to the shackles, then sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench. He needs a cog #5 and asks you to bring it back to him.

sections.title: Lucien's Verdict
sections.body: When you mention cog #5, Lucien Tosselwrench sounds doubtful about how things will go.

faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus asks you while working on a set of shackles in the Badlands.
Lotwil needs a cog #5. He asks you to bring it back after speaking with Lucien Tosselwrench.

faq.q: Who do I speak to about the cog?
faq.answer: Lotwil sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
